dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Bilateral post-paralytic facial synkinesis with left palpebral-fissure narrowing, caused by aberrant facial-nerve regeneration after prior idiopathic peripheral facial palsy (Bell’s palsy)

ALTERNATIVE 1: Ocular myasthenia gravis

ALTERNATIVE 2: Left Horner syndrome

ALTERNATIVE 3: Recurrent peripheral facial nerve palsy or facial-nerve lesion
order_raw:
